study.notes: STUDY: BELIEVE (NCT05616013), double blind placebo controlled phase 2 trial of bimagrumab, semaglutide or their combination in adults with obesity without diabetes, nine arms 1:1 each, 507 randomised, 48 week primary treatment period and extension to 72 weeks; the semaglutide alone arms (1.0 mg weekly N 56, 2.4 mg weekly N 57) are entered against placebo (N 56), the bimagrumab and combination arms are not; Table 2 gives least squares mean change from baseline plus or minus standard error per arm at week 48 (route arm_sems; treatment regimen estimand with multiple imputation for the primary and secondary endpoints, MMRM efficacy estimand for blood pressure, pulse, lipids, insulin and BMD, log transformed MMRM for lipids and insulin); HbA1c, lean mass, VAT and BMD are secondary or exploratory endpoints (prespecified TRUE), lipids and insulin exploratory; hsCRP is given in the text as ranges of LSM percent changes per drug (semaglutide minus 54.5 to minus 55.4 percent vs placebo minus 15.6 percent) without SE, not entered; pct_weight_change left empty because the Table 2 LSM difference from placebo is in kg (minus 10.9 kg for 2.4 mg, minus 6.5 kg for 1.0 mg) and the percent changes are printed as ranges across doses (semaglutide minus 9.8 to minus 13.5 percent vs placebo minus 3.5); Table 1 baselines per arm; funded by Eli Lilly (Versanis Bio) (industry_funded TRUE); rob_overall low

json.design: BELIEVE, nine arm double blind placebo controlled phase 2 trial of bimagrumab, semaglutide (1.0 or 2.4 mg) and combinations, adults with obesity without diabetes, 507 randomised, 48 week primary treatment period
json.reason: full text group (institutional route); eleven inventory markers per semaglutide dose (22 rows) as least squares mean changes with SE at week 48 from Table 2, against the shared placebo arm; bimagrumab and combination arms not entered
biomarkers_reported_no_variance: hsCRP (text: LSM percent reductions at week 48, semaglutide minus 54.5 to minus 55.4 percent vs placebo minus 15.6 percent, ranges without SE; Fig. 2f)
leptin (text: LSM change minus 20.1 to minus 20.5 ng/mL with semaglutide; Extended Data Fig. 7, not captured)
other_markers: total body fat mass and fat loss index
lumbar spine, total hip and femoral neck BMD

rob.justification: double blind placebo controlled randomisation across nine arms (D1, D2 low); intention to treat with multiple imputation and MMRM (D3 low); DXA and laboratory outcomes (D4 low); registered trial, lipids and insulin are exploratory with unadjusted nominal comparisons (D5 some concerns)

doubts: the placebo arm (N 56) is shared by the two semaglutide dose row sets
blood pressure, pulse, lipid and insulin changes use the efficacy estimand (MMRM, on treatment) while HbA1c, VAT and lean mass use the treatment regimen estimand
the 72 week extension values are in Extended Data Table 1 (not captured); rows are at the 48 week primary treatment period end

numbers check: the Table 1 placebo lipid baselines (184.2, 109.7, 121.8 mg/dL) are glued to the unit superscript in the Europe PMC rendering ('mg dl−1184.2'), so the check reports them missing although they are printed
